title: A Cipher for the Parish
author: Ivo Sandoval
blurb: Mirabel Dunmore, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
